command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek is overly restrictive because the standard read-only operation is identifiable despite missing Project acceptance values.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected bounded runner for Transport 0x0C/0x04 on the approved channel, parse all counters with pinned widths/endianness and attach timestamp/reset context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD and 10/5 timing remain preserved; channel and expected counter window are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Collect a timestamped, reset-aware, wrap-aware read-only statistics snapshot or bounded delta and compare to the Project health window.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds command identity, schema, time context and measurable acceptance to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single raw response without decoding or reset context does not validate statistics; traffic generation or counter reset is outside this case unless separately approved.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Volatile counter wrap or BMC restart can mimic traffic change, and parser errors can produce false network-health findings.

project_override_considerations: A vendor telemetry API is equivalent only if it reports the same channel-scoped IP/UDP/RMCP counters with equal timestamp, reset and width semantics; raw 0x04 coverage remains unverified if skipped.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The telemetry purpose and standard operation are identifiable. Schema, reset context and health window are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores safe read-only counter automation and prevents meaningless raw output, reset/wrap false positives, unbounded polling and automatic network changes.
independent_technical_reasoning: Network counters are cumulative and volatile, so their values are not inherently pass/fail. Meaningful evidence binds the response to channel, timestamp and reset epoch, then applies width-aware wrap logic across an explicitly approved interval; anomalies are reported for correlation rather than triggering automatic reconfiguration.
